recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: hardware passkeys replacing the old password ritual
a fitness index named after a tennis legend
algorithms searching for proof of care
diamond mines going quiet as demand fades
clear summer morning in San Francisco, daylight stretching past eight-thirty
Enya drifting through the headphones on a seventeen-degree breeze

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap on stutter-house kick drops as the beat fragments and recomposes; ghost notes appear off-grid and you must decide whether to hit or skip them.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each clean 8-bar loop unlocks a new vocal chop that layers into the track you're building.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs, off-beat ghost notes multiply, and skipping too many drops mutes the bass entirely.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon waveform pulse on San Francisco fog

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Drag rotating passkey glyphs into alignment slots before a vault gate slams shut; decoy factors try to trick you into wrong combinations.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Satisfying mechanical click and green flash when all authentication factors snap into place.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: More factor slots per round, shorter fuse, decoy glyphs that look almost right.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: brushed metal tiles on matte black

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Hold to water a wilting summer plant—release when dew beads appear on the leaves; hold too long and roots rot, release too early and it withers.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Each successful care cycle blooms the plant into a new species with a brief watercolor flourish.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Wilting cycles speed up, wind gusts steal moisture mid-hold, and thirsty neighboring sprouts compete for attention.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor botanical sketch on cream paper

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick gems down a narrowing mineshaft; swipe between lanes to catch matching crystal colors before they pile up and seal the shaft.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: swipe to switch lanes, flick to shatter clusters
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Chain reactions collapse entire strata in one cascading screen-clear.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Shaft narrows each round, rare black diamonds absorb light and hide their true color until shattered.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: crystalline low-poly cavern with dim headlamp glow
